Kira: Heads up — putting together a variant-corridor playbook to standardize how we bring quant variants from hosted -> dedicated -> private. Want a short, operational checklist we can follow for future AWQ/GPTQ/Fp8/INT8 experiments.

Sam: +1. Can we make the quality gates explicit? past rollouts were a bit ad-hoc.

Michael: Draft metrics to gate on: relative accuracy delta across our golden prompt set < 1% (macro avg), hallucination rate delta < 0.5pp, safety filter false positives no worse than baseline, p95 latency increase < 20ms, token-cost delta < 25%. Also require eval coverage across short/long/context-switch prompts.

Tara: Also propose traffic progression schedule: canary 0.1% (4h smoke) -> 1% (12h) -> 5% (24h) -> 20% (24-48h) -> 100% (monitor 72h). Each step must pass the automated regression checks.

Kira: Agree. For fallback chains: primary variant -> fallback-compat (e.g., FP16 or higher-precision model) -> route-to-hosted-compatible (if dedicated overloaded). Automated rollback triggers: any gate fail, sustained error rate > 0.5% for 10m, or p95 latency > configured SLOs for 15m.

Sam: How do we handle per-tenant pinning? some enterprise customers pin to a locked model+quant config.

Kira: We keep pin-to-version as a first-class flag. Rollouts ignore pinned tenants by default. We can opt-in a tenant to canary with explicit consent. Add a tenant opt-in list in rollout config.

Michael: Proposed smoke test harness (run every step):
- golden_set_id: golden-v2
- buckets: short(<=64), medium(65-512), long(>512)
- metrics: acc_delta, hallucination_rate, lint_issues, latency_p95
- run_id: smoke-<timestamp>

ci-bot: smoke-run 1835019123 completed: acc_delta 0.6%, hallucination +0.2pp, p95 +12ms, cost delta +18% — provisional pass for 0.1% -> 1% step. https://ci.internal/runs/1835019123

Tara: Note: private deployments need manual compliance sign-off before any quant variant can be enabled. Also ensure KMS keys are validated.

ops-bot: capacity-check: dedicated pool has 60% headroom for the new quant flavor; if autoscale triggers >80% for >10m route to hosted fallback. Budget alert if sustained >40% of reserved for 24h.

Kira: Putting a sample rollout policy below — this is just a sketch we can translate into config for the controller.

Kira: ```
rollout: 
  name: awq-1.2-corridor
  steps:
    - percent: 0.1
      duration: 4h
      smoke_tests: [golden-v2, perf-smoke]
    - percent: 1
      duration: 12h
    - percent: 5
      duration: 24h
    - percent: 20
      duration: 24h
    - percent: 100
      duration: 72h
  gates:
    - type: metric_threshold
      metric: acc_delta
      threshold: 1.0
    - type: metric_threshold
      metric: p95_latency_increase_ms
      threshold: 20
  fallbacks:
    - to: fp16-default
      trigger: gate_fail
    - to: hosted-compatible-variant
      trigger: capacity_overflow
  tenant_pinning: true
  private_deploy_requirements: [compliance_signoff, kms_check]
```

Sam: Nice. Can we add an automated golden-set sampling to detect prompt-pattern regressions? (e.g., copy/formatting, table outputs)

Michael: Yes — add per-category thresholds and a small token-level diff check for structured outputs. We'll add a regression alert if >2 prompts in the golden set degrade beyond the threshold.

Tara: One more operational note: for Dedicated->Private handoff we need a DB migration window for model-profile metadata and a runbook to squash cached KV differences. Add that to the onboarding docs.

Kira: I'll draft the playbook doc and the rollout controller PR. Plan: create a template in repo inference/rollouts/templates and start with AWQ-1.2 as the first canonical example.

Sam: Sounds good. If you post the PR I can run the initial smoke job on a dev sandbox.

ci-bot: created issue INF-8421: "variant corridor playbook + rollout controller template"

Kira: Thanks — will ping when PR is up. :thumbsup:
